variants.hg_fork: Han & Gardent's fork code path (strip trailing ?+ on the joined string; EM lowercased; spaCy-lemma GED; >budget items dropped from GED)
variants.hg_paper_literal: footnote 11 read literally: every sub-question and the question lowercased, trailing ? and whitespace stripped, then the hg_fork path

deviations_from_han_gardent: spaCy version: the fork pins spacy==2.1.9 (Python <= 3.8); this run uses the environment's spaCy 3.x and en_core_web_sm 3.x, recorded under environment. Lemmas differ between the two (e.g. -PRON-), so GED's node cost is the official algorithm over spaCy-3 lemmas.

GED budget: tested between the optimizer's approximations rather than by interrupting one (official @exit_after); an over-budget item is dropped from the GED mean as the official aggregator does, and every drop is counted.

Gold: MuSiQue's stored sub-questions, including the 'entity >> relation' (Zero-Shot RE) form. Han & Gardent rewrote those to natural language with their own templates, so absolute EM/SARI/GED are not on an identical gold; this is a property of the gold, not of the scorer.
Gold join: exp-030's per-item gold is joined by question text (issue #57); 6 dev question texts occur twice, 5 with differing gold. Carried unchanged.

paired_family.correction: Holm-Bonferroni over the whole family (ADR 0036); uncorrected verdict kept beside it
